title: PlacePulse: Learning Transferable Place Representations from Structural Geographic Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.13390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geospatial machine learning often depends on task-specific feature engineering over large collections of sociodemographic, business, and environmental variables. Geospatial foundation models offer reusable representations of place, but leading approaches typically encode dynamic signals, such as mobility and search activity, or visual signals from satellite imagery. Few models represent the static structural composition of places (who lives and works there, which businesses operate there, and which risks they face) as transferable embeddings at fine spatial resolution. We introduce PlacePulse, a structural geospatial foundation model that compresses 572 attributes, expanded to 2,288 inputs through H3 neighborhood aggregates, into 256-dimensional unit-norm embeddings for 1,055,537 H3 resolution-7 cells in the United States. We also introduce a reusable two-axis benchmark that separates intrinsic representation quality from downstream pred

translated_title: PlacePulse：从结构性地理数据中学习可迁移的地点表示
translated_abstract: 地理空间机器学习通常依赖于对大量社会人口、商业和环境变量进行特定任务的特征工程。地理空间基础模型虽然提供了可复用的地点表示，但主流方法通常编码的是动态信号（如人口流动和搜索活动）或来自卫星影像的视觉信号。很少有模型将地点的静态结构组成（谁在那里生活和工作、哪些企业在此经营、以及它们面临哪些风险）表示为精细空间分辨率下的可迁移嵌入。我们提出了PlacePulse，这是一个结构性地理空间基础模型，它将572个属性（通过H3邻域聚合扩展为2,288个输入）压缩为256维的单位范数嵌入，覆盖美国1,055,537个H3分辨率-7单元。我们还引入了一个可复用的双轴基准，将内在表示质量与下游预测（性能）分离开来。
tldr: PlacePulse是一个结构性地理空间基础模型，它将美国超过105万个H3区域的572个静态结构属性压缩为可迁移的256维嵌入表示，并配套提出了区分内在表示质量与下游预测性能的双轴评估基准。
en_tdlr: PlacePulse is a structural geospatial foundation model that compresses 572 static structural attributes into transferable 256-dimensional embeddings for over 1 million H3 cells across the US, accompanied by a reusable two-axis benchmark that separates intrinsic representation quality from downstream predictive performance.
